node.statement: Target algebra and projection clauses. Apply lem-compcb-corner-algebra to the nonvanishing t-projection P_R in the extended epsilon_A-C*-algebra A. It makes A_R=S^A_{P_R}, with compressed product, inherited involution, and unit I_{A_R}=Co^A_{P_R}(P_R), an extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra for epsilon_{A_R}=C_ca*(t+epsilon_A)<=2*C_ca*t. Apply lem-maincb-nested-corner-comparison to (R,P,Q)=(P_R,P_U,P_j), using node 1.2: P_U^R and P_j^R are C_nest*t-projections in A_R.
